user.title: Add a GO DAIKIN air conditioner
user.description: Sign in with your GO DAIKIN account to fetch the unit's local key, or enter a key you already have. After setup, all control stays on your local network.

menu_options.cloud: Sign in with GO DAIKIN account

dhcp_confirm.title: GO DAIKIN unit found
dhcp_confirm.description: Unit {thing_name} was found at {host}. Sign in with your GO DAIKIN account on the next step to fetch its local key.

cloud.title: GO DAIKIN account
cloud.description: Your credentials are used once to fetch the per-unit key and are not stored.

data_description.username: The email address you use in the GO DAIKIN app.

data_description.thing_name: Units on the account that are not configured yet. An IP address in brackets means the unit answered discovery.

data_description.host: Pre-filled when the unit answered discovery; otherwise find it in your router. A DHCP reservation is recommended.
data_description.name: Shown in Home Assistant, for example the room name.
data_description.port: Leave at 7002 unless you know the unit uses another port.
data_description.five_speed_fan: Normally detected automatically from the unit; only force it if a 5-speed unit shows three fan speeds.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: The unit key is the 32-character hex key the GO DAIKIN cloud assigns to this unit.

data_description.host: Address of the unit on your network.
data_description.thing_name: Identifier such as Daikin_aabbccddeeff, as returned by discovery.
data_description.name: Shown in Home Assistant, for example the room name.
data_description.port: Leave at 7002 unless you know the unit uses another port.
data_description.five_speed_fan: Normally detected automatically from the unit.

reauth_confirm.title: Unit key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: {thing_name} no longer accepts its key. Sign in again to fetch the current one.

data_description.username: The email address you use in the GO DAIKIN app.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {thing_name}
reconfigure.description: Change the network address or name. The connection is tested before saving.

data_description.host: New address of the unit on your network.
data_description.name: Shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.port: Leave at 7002 unless you know the unit uses another port.
data_description.five_speed_fan: Normally detected automatically from the unit.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address, that the unit is on your network, and that TCP port 7002 is reachable from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_key: The unit answered but the reply could not be decrypted. The key is wrong or has changed.
error.no_units: No units with a key were found on this account.
error.unit_not_in_account: This unit is not paired with that account.

abort.all_configured: Every unit on this account is already configured.
abort.not_godaikin_device: The discovered device is not a GO DAIKIN unit.

init.title: Supported features
init.description: Detected from your GO DAIKIN account at setup. Adjust if the unit actually supports more or less than shown.

data.cloud_sensors: Cloud sensors (room temperature, coil/outdoor temperatures, power, compressor data)

data_description.hvac_modes: Cooling-only units have cool, dry and fan; heat and auto only exist on heat-pump models.
data_description.fan_speeds: 3 for remotes with three fan bars, 5 for remotes with five.
data_description.swing: Untick if the unit has no motorised louver.
data_description.cloud_sensors: Opt-in. Control stays local; only sensor values are read from your GO DAIKIN account. Keeps a revocable refresh token, never your password.
data_description.cloud_interval: How often to read the cloud shadow (5–120 minutes). One call covers every unit on the account and is shared between them; 10 minutes keeps well clear of API limits.

cloud_login.title: Sign in for cloud sensors
cloud_login.description: Used once to obtain a refresh token for this unit. The password is not stored.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the GO DAIKIN cloud.
error.unit_not_in_account: This unit is not paired with that account.

command_failed.message: Command to the GO DAIKIN unit at {host} failed: {error}

key_rejected.message: The GO DAIKIN unit at {host} rejected its key; re-authentication has been requested
